findings.text: blocking: after any retirement the re-read replaces queued with every queued pointer in the fleet, so on a named admission (admit_once(run_id=...), reached by `crew admit --run` at reckon/crew_run_commands.py:6133, whose docstring at :6124 states it 'returns after deciding only the named queued request ... and leaves unrelated requests untouched') line 303's `order = placeable if run_id` now ranks and can launch unrelated requests; the retirement loop at holds.py:1282 also ranges over every live pointer in that same named pass. Seen when a lost session holds any queued review: the named run is no longer the only candidate.

non-blocking: run_id is appended to retired, and a retired-lost-session verdict row written, whether or not the discard went through, so a discard that refuses (handled at holds.py:1232) is still reported retired and listed in result['retired_lost_session'] and the pass receipt, contradicting _retire_lost_session_review's own docstring at holds.py:1206-1209; the pointer is stamped and the next pass retries, but the pass's record says the request left when it did not.

non-blocking: _stamp_discard_reason duplicates recovery_review_dispatch._discard_stranded_review (reckon/crew/recovery_review_dispatch.py:888) line for line in its discard call, its marker lookup over discard_record_path/discard_spool_path and its three refusal sentences, differing only in the extra lost_session/last_heard_at/rule fields; extending the owner with an extra-fields argument would keep one implementation of writing a reason onto a departure. The same applies to _record_lost_session_retirement (holds.py:1246), which is _record_retirement (holds.py:1082) with a different record payload.

non-blocking: the reflex derives lostness from LostSessionReads(pointers=scoring), only the records this project owes a review, where the admit pass uses every live pointer; session_lost dates a session from its oldest record when no lease or process is heard, so a session whose live records predate the scoring run reads younger here than in the admit pass and its review is composed rather than suppressed -- an under-detection that keeps the old behaviour the node exists to stop.

non-blocking: the node's declared evidence fragment and figures directory were not delivered, and every sibling section under docs/evidence/fragments/work-of-a-lost-session-is-raised-not-left/ carries one, so this section has no artifact for the plan's evidence record.
